name: Osananajimi
source:
Main character has a childhood friend and a sister that he loves both dearly. But the day comes when he needs to make a decision and choose between them.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/09/vn-of-month-december-1997.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主角有一位青梅竹马和一个妹妹，两人都是他深爱的人。然而，必须在她们之间做出选择的日子，终究还是到来了。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/09/vn-of-month-december-1997.html]vndbreview[/url]]
